reasons: Red: CCC credit spread (OAS), AI basket drawdown / momentum, Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL), Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 3.31% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +20bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (-0.1pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 11bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.1bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 162 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 107 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 18.4 sits at the 69th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 10.5, so implied carries +8.0 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: AI credit fears push tech default insurance to record highs
items.note: Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Nvidia CDS hit record levels alongside Oracle and CoreWeave, showing market-wide repricing of AI-infrastructure credit risk.

items.headline: CoreWeave 5-year CDS tops 1,000bp; unsecured notes trade at 76-81 cents
items.note: Implied multi-year default odds above 60% and 15-16% bond yields signal a sharply higher refinancing cost for the largest neocloud borrower (CDS figures vary by source).

items.headline: Oracle 5-year CDS rises to 288bp from 260bp a week earlier
items.source: S&P Global Market Intelligence via roic.ai
